name: ApproveProcessInstance

parameters.help_en:
The process instance ID. Approval tickets from both the new and legacy Security Center are supported.

Call the ListPendingApprovals (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2024-05-18/ListPendingApprovals) operation with the same caller identity and filter the results by the `DefSchema` and `ResourceType` of the application ticket, such as `DefSchema=MaxCompute` and `ResourceType=["table"]`. Obtain the value from `Data.Data[].ProcessInstanceId` of the target record. When you call the ListMyRelatedApprovals (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2024-05-18/ListMyRelatedApprovals) operation, you can also specify `Statuses=["WaitApproval"]` to filter pending approval records. The return path for the process instance ID is the same
parameters.help_zh:
流程实例 ID，支持新、老安全中心的审批单。

使用同一调用身份调用 ListPendingApprovals (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2024-05-18/ListPendingApprovals)，按申请单对应的 `DefSchema` 和 `ResourceType` 筛选，例如 `DefSchema=MaxCompute`、`ResourceType=["table"]`。从目标记录的 `Data.Data[].ProcessInstanceId` 取值。使用 ListMyRelatedApprovals (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2024-05-18/ListMyRelatedApprovals) 查询时，还可传入 `Statuses=["WaitApproval"]` 筛选待审批记录，流程实例 ID 的返回路径相同
